title: Steven Greer's practice of calling UFOs in
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Steven Greer's practice of calling UFOs in, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a UFO researcher named Steven Greer, whose work he calls a mixed bag but says is now being vindicated in many ways. According to Michels, Greer believes ordinary people can try to "call in" UFOs, summoning them on purpose. If that were true, contact would be open to anyone, not just governments.
